summary: The Clinton County Regional Educational Service Agency emphasizes the importance of preserving E-Rate funding to ensure schools can maintain reliable, affordable internet access for students and staff. They express concern that changes to E-Rate could have serious negative consequences for students' ability to learn.

claims.argument: Without E-Rate funding, schools may be forced to use outdated equipment or redirect funds from other programs.
claims.evidence_quote: At a time when student learning depends so heavily on internet access and a robust, reliable network, either option could have serious negative effects on students’ ability to learn.
